_meta.description: Правила DQ по материалам для логического dm_product_general.
_meta.note: Ключи, начинающиеся с _, checker игнорирует. Пустые значения в Conformity пропускаются.

MARA.rule_description: For FG (MTART= ZFG, ZFGS) the value for MEINS should be "CS", "ST" or "PC" in MARA View
technical_definition: IF base_unit_of_measure_code IS NULL OR general_item_category_group_code = 'ZFGD' THEN ''
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('ZCVI', 'ZCVP', 'ZSNK') AND base_unit_of_measure_code IN (CS, PC, ST) THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('ZCVI', 'ZCVP', 'ZSNK') AND base_unit_of_measure_code NOT IN (CS, PC, ST) THEN '0'

MARA.rule_description: For Material Type (MTART)=ZNVL, ZKIT check if MTPOS_MARA = NORM/ZWST in MARA View
technical_definition: ELSE IF (material_type_code IN (ZNVL) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('NORM', 'ZWST')) OR (material_type_code IN (ZKIT) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('NORM')) THEN '1'
ELSE IF (material_type_code IN (ZNVL) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('NORM', 'ZWST')) OR (material_type_code IN (ZKIT) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('NORM')) THEN '0'

MARA.rule_description: For Material Type (MTART)= ZSV check if MTPOS_MARA = LEIS or ZLIS in MARA View
technical_definition: ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSV) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('LEIS', 'ZLIS') THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSV) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('LEIS', 'ZLIS') THEN '0'

MARA.rule_description: For Material Type (MTART)= ZSTL check if MTPOS_MARA = LEIS in MARA View
technical_definition: ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSTL) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('LEIS') THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSTL) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('LEIS') THEN '0'

MARA.rule_description: If MTART = ZFGC the value should be: 1111005, 1111006, 1111007, 1111009, 1113002 in MARA View
technical_definition: ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND material_group_code IN (1111005, 1111006, 1111007, 1111009, 1113002) THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code = 'ZFGC' AND material_group_code NOT IN (1111005, 1111006, 1111007, 1111009, 1113002) THEN '0'

MARA.rule_description: For FG, Minimum Remaining shelf life <= Total shelf life in MARA View
technical_definition: IF material_type_name_unified = 'Finished Goods' AND remaining_shelf_life <= total_shelf_life THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_name_unified = 'Finished Goods' AND remaining_shelf_life > total_shelf_life THEN '0'

MARA.rule_description: For MTART = ZFG, ZFGS, ZFGC, ZFGM, ZFGA, ZNVM check GEWEI = KG in MARA View
technical_definition: IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS, ZFGC, ZFGM, ZFGA, ZNVM) AND weight_unit = 'KG' THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS, ZFGC, ZFGM, ZFGA, ZNVM) AND weight_unit != 'KG' THEN '0'

MAKT.rule_description: Material Description should be always in UPPER CASE for All material types in MAKT View
Material description should not contain any extra or multiple spaces for All material types in MAKT View
MAKT.technical_definition: IF material_description starts or ends with space or has more than one space between characters THEN '0' ELSE '1'

AUSP_EQUIPMENT.rule_description: The BPP code (ATWRT) assigned to the Material should exist in the BPP reference table in AUSP View
technical_definition: IF bpp_code IS NULL OR bpp_code = 'ZZZZZZZZZZ' THEN ''
ELSE IF material_type_code LIKE 'ZFG%' AND bpp_name IS NOT NULL THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code LIKE 'ZFG%' AND bpp_name IS NULL THEN '0'
AUSP_EQUIPMENT.datamart_or_reference_table_used: dm_product_general; CAWN_M + CAWNT_M (BPP catalog), CABN, AUSP_EQUIPMENT
